How to Install in Thunderbird
  1. Download and save the file to your hard disk.
  2. In Mozilla Thunderbird, open Add-ons from the Tools menu.
  3. From the options button next to the add-on search field, select "Install Add-on From File..." and locate the downloaded add-on.

Conas a Shuiteáil in Thunderbird
  1. Íoslódáil agus sábháil an comhad ar do dhiosca crua.
  2. In Mozilla Thunderbird, oscail 'Breiseáin' ón roghchlár 'Uirlisí'.
  3. Ón chnaipe roghanna in aice leis an réimse cuardaigh, roghnaigh "Suiteáil Breiseán Ó Chomhad..." agus aimsigh an breiseán íoslódáilte.

We believe that large and publicly available voice datasets foster innovation and healthy commercial competition in machine-learning based speech technology. This is a global effort and we invite everyone to participate. Our aim is to help speech technology be more inclusive, reflecting the diversity of voices from around the world.

Creidimid go gcothóidh tacar sonraí ollmhór oscailte nuálaíocht agus iomaíocht shláintiúil i dteicneolaíocht aitheanta cainte bunaithe ar an ríomhfhoghlaim. Is feachtas domhanda é seo, agus fearaimid fáilte roimh chách. Sprioc amháin atá againn ná teicneolaíocht cainte níos uilechuimsithí a chothú, teicneolaíocht a oibríonn leis an éagsúlacht guthanna ó thimpeall an domhain.

The Default Browser Agent task checks when the default changes from { -brand-short-name } to another browser. If the change happens under suspicious circumstances, it will prompt users to change back to { -brand-short-name } no more than two times. This task is installed automatically by { -brand-short-name }, and is reinstalled when { -brand-short-name } updates. To disable this task, update the “default-browser-agent.enabled” preference on the about:config page or the { -brand-short-name } enterprise policy setting “DisableDefaultBrowserAgent”.

Má tharlaíonn an t-athrú in imthosca amhrasacha, spreagfaidh sé úsáideoirí gan athrú ar ais go { -brand-short-name } níos mó ná dhá uair. Tá an tasc seo suiteáilte go huathoibríoch ag { -brand-short-name }, agus athshuiteáiltear é nuair a nuashonraíonn { -brand-short-name }. Chun an tasc seo a dhíchumasú, nuashonraigh an rogha “default-browser-agent.enabled” ar an leathanach about:config nó ar an socrú polasaí fiontair { -brand-short-name } “DisableDefaultBrowserAgent”.

Firefox Health Report (FHR) analyses your browser's performance information, in order to provide you with useful tips that help you get the best from Firefox. For more information on Firefox Health Report, visit the Mozilla Support section.

Déanann an Tuairisc Shláinte Firefox (FHR) anailís ar fheidhmíocht do bhrabhsálaí, chun cabhrú leat an tairbhe is mó a bhaint as Firefox. Chun tuilleadh eolais faoin Tuairisc Shláinte a fháil, féach ar Thacaíocht Mhozilla.

Firefox Health Report (FHR) records anonymous data about your computer, configuration, usage, performance, and error conditions. This data helps us improve Firefox for you and for other Firefox users.

Taifeadann Tuairisc Shláinte Firefox (FHR) sonraí gan ainm faoi do ríomhaire, a chumraíocht, úsáid, feidhmíocht, agus earráidí. Cabhraíonn na sonraí seo linn Firefox a fheabhsú ar do shonsa agus ar son úsáideoirí eile.
Firefox Health Report lets you know how your Firefox is performing and what you can do to improve it.
Tugann Tuairisc Shláinte Firefox faisnéis duit maidir le feidhmíocht Firefox agus conas is féidir feabhas a chur air.
Firefox Health Report lets you optimize your Firefox and helps us build a more excellent browser. Reports will be pretty basic at first, but will continue to evolve and grow.

Is féidir leat an Tuairisc Shláinte a úsáid chun Firefox a optamú, agus is mór an chabhair dúinn na sonraí seo agus Firefox á fheabhsú. I dtosach báire, ní fhaigheann tú ach tuairiscí an-simplí, ach éireoidh siad níos cuimsithí de réir a chéile.
Firefox Health Report records information about your browser and device. You can see the information we record. You can also see what you share with Mozilla.

Déanann Tuairisc Shláinte Firefox taifead ar fhaisnéis a bhaineann le do bhrabhsálaí agus le do ghléas. Is féidir leat an fhaisnéis seo go léir a fheiceáil. Is féidir na sonraí a sheolann tú chuig Mozilla a fheiceáil freisin.
Firefox is distributed through channels: Nightly builds, the Aurora pre-release channel, a stable Beta, and the public release. This field identifies the channel.
Cuirimid Firefox ar fáil trí "chainéil": leaganacha turgnamhacha laethúla, réamhleaganacha Aurora, leagan béite (níos cobhsaí), agus an leagan poiblí oifigiúil. Is é an cainéal atá sa réimse seo.

For each browsing session, Firefox Health Report records approximately how long you browsed (in seconds), and whether the session ended normally or because of a crash. Also includes startup times (in milliseconds) if available.
I ngach seisiún brabhsála, taifeadann an Tuairisc Shláinte cé chomh fada a bhí tú ag brabhsáil (soicindí), agus aon tuairteáil a tharla. Cuireann sé amanna tosaithe san áireamh freisin, más féidir.

Firefox Input is Mozilla's primary feedback mechanism for products. It is set up to be a method of one-way communication about your experiences in using our products, the Internet you view it through, and what Mozilla can do to make that experience better. The system is available over a wide-variety of submission mechanisms and product builds.

Is é Firefox Input príomhchóras aiseolais Mhozilla. Is éard atá ann ná modh cumarsáide aontreo maidir lenár dtáirgí, an tIdirlíon a bhrabhsálann tú tríd, agus na rudaí is féidir le Mozilla a dhéanamh le feabhas a chur ar do chuairt ar líne. Tugann an córas bealaí éagsúla duit le haiseolas a sheoladh chugainn, agus is féidir aiseolas faoi na trí phríomhleagan atá againn a sheoladh.

Welcome to the Mozilla Demo Studio, where developers like you can develop, share, demonstrate, and learn all about Web technologies. See what's possible by exploring Demo Studio:

  • View demos that showcase what HTML, CSS, and JavaScript can do.
  • Inspect the source code for those demos so you can see how they work.
  • Read documentation to learn about the open standards and technologies that power the Web.

Fáilte go Stiúideo Taispeántas Mozilla, áit inar féidir le forbróirí a gcuid oibre a chomhroinnt agus chur ar taispeáint, agus tuilleadh eolais a fháil faoi theicneolaíochtaí Gréasáin. Taiscéal an Stiúideo agus féach ar na rudaí go léir is féidir a dhéanamh:

  • Féach ar thaispeántais a léiríonn cumhacht HTML, CSS, agus JavaScript.
  • Iniúch cód foinseach na dtaispeántas sin sa chaoi go dtuigfidh tú an chaoi a n-oibríonn siad.
  • Léigh doiciméadú chun tuilleadh eolais a fháil faoi na teicneolaíochtaí agus na caighdeáin oscailte a chumhachtaíonn an Gréasán.

Whether you are creating an amazing new way to experience the Web or just experimenting with the latest technologies, we invite you to submit your own demos to share with (or show off to) other web developers.

An bhfuil bealach úrnua le sult a bhaint as an nGréasán agat? Nó nach bhfuil tú ach ag baint triail as na teicneolaíochtaí is déanaí? Is cuma linn agus fearaimid fáilte romhat do chuid taispeántas a chur faoinár mbráid chun iad a chomhroinnt le forbróirí Gréasáin eile.

• You must be prepared to provide the source code for your demo. Demos are hosted on the Demo Studio's servers.

  • Your demo should showcase open web technologies, such as HTML5 and CSS3.
  • Your demo should support a wide range of modern web browsers, like Firefox, Chrome, Safari, and Opera.

• Caithfidh tú cód foinseach do thaispeántais a sholáthar. Beidh na taispeántais óstáilte ar fhreastalaithe an Stiúideo Taispeántas.
  • Ní mór duit cód foinseach do thaispeántas a chur ar fáil faoi cheadúnas oscailte, mar shampla MPL, GPL, nó BSD.
  • Ba chóir don taispeántas teicneolaíochtaí oscailte an Ghréasáin a chur ar taispeáint, mar shampla HTML5 agus CSS3.
  • Ba chóir don taispeántas tacú le raon leathan de bhrabhsálaithe nua-aimseartha, mar shampla Firefox, Chrome, Safari and Opera.

• Your demo's source code should be packaged inside a ZIP file.
  • The main page of your demo should be a file named index.html in the root of the ZIP.
  • Your demo should be built on client-side technology (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Server-side languages like PHP and Ruby are not supported.
  • If your demo requires external resources, it should use AJAX to access them.
  • Please identify in the demo details box any 3rd party content that can't be licensed under the CC-BY-SA license and include links to the authors' websites.

• Caithfidh tú cód foinseach do thaispeántais a phacáistiú i gcomhad ZIP.

  • Ní mór duit do thaispeántas a chruthú le teicneolaíocht ar thaobh an chliaint (HTML, CSS, Javascript). Ní thacaítear le PHP, Ruby, nó teangacha eile ar thaobh an fhreastalaí.
  • Má tá acmhainní seachtracha de dhíth ar do thaispeántas, ba chóir dó AJAX a úsáid.
  • Cuir in iúl dúinn i mbosca mionsonraithe an taispeántais aon ábhar atá ann nach féidir chur ar fáil faoi cheadúnas CC-BY-SA agus cuir nasc le suímh Ghréasáin na n-údar ann chomh maith.

Firefox is a browser with a conscience. As part of the technology non-profit Mozilla, we fight for your online rights, keep corporate powers in check and help educate developing countries on healthy Internet practices. So when you choose Firefox, we’re choosing you, too.

Is é Firefox an brabhsálaí amháin le coinsias sóisialta. Nuair a roghnaíonn tú Firefox, roghnaímid thú.

Firefox is built by a non-profit. That means we can do things that others can’t, like build new products and features without a hidden agenda. We champion your right to privacy with tools like Private Browsing with Tracking Protection, which go beyond what Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge offer.

Tá Firefox forbartha ag eagraíocht neamhbhrabúis. Ciallaíonn sé sin gur féidir linn táirgí agus gnéithe nua a thógáil gan aidhmeanna folaigh. Seasaimid ar son cheart an phríobháideachais le huirlisí éagsúla, mar shampla Brabhsáil Phríobháideach agus Cosaint ar Lorgaireacht, uirlisí atá i bhfad Éireann níos fearr ná na cinn atá ar fáil in Google Chrome nó Microsoft Edge.
Firefox is independent and a part of the non-profit Mozilla, which fights for your online rights, keeps corporate powers in check and makes the Internet accessible to everyone, everywhere.

Tá Firefox neamhspleách agus tá sé forbartha faoi scáth Mozilla, eagraíocht neamhbhrabúis a throideann ar son do cheart ar líne, a choinníonn srian ar na mórchomhlachtaí corparáideacha, agus a chuireann an tIdirlíon ar fáil do gach uile dhuine i ngach uile áit.
Firefox is non-profit, non-corporate, non-compromised. Choosing Firefox isn’t just choosing a browser. It’s a vote for personal freedom.

The Mozilla project is a global community of people who believe that openness, innovation, and opportunity are key to the continued health of the Internet. We have worked together since 1998 to ensure that the Internet is developed in a way that benefits everyone. We are best known for creating the Mozilla Firefox web browser.

Is éard atá i dtionscadal Mozilla ná comhphobal domhanda a chreideann gurb iad an oscailteacht, an nuálaíocht, agus deiseanna na rudaí a chinnteoidh sláinte an Idirlín san fhadtréimhse. Táimid ag obair le chéile ó 1998 chun deimhniú go bhforbraítear an tIdirlíon ar leas an phobail. Is fearr aithne orainn as an mbrabhsálaí Mozilla Firefox.

The Mozilla project uses a community-based approach to create world-class open source software and to develop new types of collaborative activities. We create communities of people involved in making the Internet experience better for all of us.

Baineann tionscadal Mozilla úsáid as cur chuige pobalbhunaithe chun bogearraí den chéad scoth a chruthú agus chun gníomhaíochtaí comhoibríocha a fhorbairt. Cruthaímid comhphobail atá ag iarraidh feabhas a chur ar an Idirlíon ar ár son uilig.

There are many different ways of advancing the principles of the Mozilla Manifesto. We welcome a broad range of activities, and anticipate the same creativity that Mozilla participants have shown in other areas of the project. For individuals not deeply involved in the Mozilla project, one basic and very effective way to support the Manifesto is to use Mozilla Firefox and other products that embody the principles of the Manifesto.

Tá go leor bealaí ann chun prionsabail an Fhorógra a chur chun cinn. Fearaimid fáilte roimh réimse leathan gníomhaíochtaí, agus táimid ag súil leis an leibhéal céanna cruthaitheachta atá léirithe ag rannpháirtithe Mozilla i gcodanna eile den tionscadal. Is féidir le haon duine prionsabail an Fhorógra a thacú, fiú daoine nach bhfuil ceangal láidir acu le Mozilla, trí Firefox agus táirgí eile a chuimsíonn na prionsabail seo a úsáid.
These are the principles that guide our mission to promote openness, innovation & opportunity on the Web.
Seo iad na prionsabail is bonn lenár misean, is é sin oscailteacht, nuálaíocht, agus deiseanna a chur chun cinn ar an nGréasán.

These principles will not come to life on their own. People are needed to make the Internet open and participatory - people acting as individuals, working together in groups, and leading others. The Mozilla Foundation is committed to advancing the principles set out in the Mozilla Manifesto. We invite others to join us and make the Internet an ever better place for everyone.

Ní thiocfaidh na prionsabail seo chun beatha ina n-aonar. Daoine amháin atá in ann an tIdirlíon a choinneáil oscailte agus daonlathach — daoine ina n-aonar, daoine ag obair i ngrúpaí, agus daoine ag spreagadh daoine eile. Tá Fondúireacht Mhozilla go hiomlán tugtha do na prionsabail atá leagtha amach i bhForógra Mozilla. Fearaimid fáilte roimh éinne atá ag iarraidh obair a dhéanamh linn chun feabhas a chur ar an Idirlíon.

{ $command } <status message>: set the status to { $status } with an optional status message.
{ $command } <stádas>: socraigh { $status } mar stádas, le teachtaireacht roghnach.
{ $commandName }: Display a list of chat rooms on the network. Warning, some servers may disconnect you upon doing this.
{ $commandName }: Taispeáin liosta na seomraí comhrá ar an líonra. Rabhadh: Dícheanglófar ó fhreastalaithe áirithe thú má dhéanann tú é seo.
{ $commandName }: Displays the current local time at the IRC server.
{ $commandName }: Taispeáin an t-am áitiúil ag an bhfreastalaí IRC.
{ $commandName } [<channel>] [(+|-)<new mode> [<parameter>][,<parameter>]*]: Get, set, or unset a channel mode.
{ $commandName } [<cainéal>] [(+|-)<mód nua> [<paraiméadar>][,<paraiméadar>]*]: Faigh, socraigh, nó díshocraigh mód an chainéil.
{ $commandName } <command>: Send a raw command to the server.
{ $commandName } <jid>[<message>]: Invite a user to join the current room with an optional message.
{ $commandName } <jid>[<teachtaireacht>]: Tabhair cuireadh d'úsáideoir chuig an seomra reatha, le teachtaireacht roghnach.
{ $commandName } <message>: Disconnect from the server, with an optional message.
{ $commandName } <teachtaireacht>: Dícheangail ón bhfreastalaí, le teachtaireacht roghnach.
{ $commandName } [<message>]: Leave the current room with an optional message.
{ $commandName } [<teachtaireacht>]: Fág an seomra reatha le teachtaireacht roghnach.
{ $commandName } (+|-)<new mode>: Set or unset a user mode.
{ $commandName } (+|-)<mód nua>: Socraigh nó díshocraigh mód úsáideora.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Grant channel operator status to someone. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <leasainm1>[,<leasainm2>]*: Bronn stádas oibreora an chainéil ar dhuine éigin. Ní mór duit a bheith i d'oibreoir cainéil chun é seo a dhéanamh.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Grant channel voice status to someone. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <leasainm1>[,<leasainm2>]*: Tabhair cead cainte ar an gcainéal do dhuine éigin. Ní mór duit a bheith i d'oibreoir cainéil chun é seo a dhéanamh.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Remove channel operator status from someone. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <leasainm1>[,<leasainm2>]*: Bain stádas oibreoir an chainéil de dhuine éigin. Ní mór duit a bheith i d'oibreoir cainéil chun é seo a dhéanamh.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Remove channel voice status from someone, preventing them from speaking if the channel is moderated (+m). You must be a channel operator to do this.

{ $commandName } <leasainm1>[,<leasainm2>]*: Bain cead cainte ar an gcainéal ó dhuine éigin, sa chaoi nach mbeidh sé/sí in ann labhairt ar chainéal modhnaithe (+m). Ní mór duit a bheith i d'oibreoir cainéil chun é seo a dhéanamh.
{ $commandName } [<nick>]: Asks how much lag a user (or the server if no user specified) has.
{ $commandName } [<leasainm>]: Fiafraigh cad é an mhoille ar an líonra don úsáideoir (nó ag an bhfreastalaí mura bhfuil úsáideoir ann).
{ $commandName } <nick>[<message>]: Ban someone from the room. You must be a room administrator to do this.
{ $commandName } <leasainm>[<teachtaireacht>]: Cuir cosc ar dhuine sa seomra. Ní mór duit a bheith i do riarthóir chun é seo a dhéanamh.
{ $commandName } <nick> [<message>]: Remove someone from a channel. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <leasainm> [<teachtaireacht>]: Bain duine éigin de chainéal. Ní mór duit a bheith i d'oibreoir cainéil chun é seo a dhéanamh.
{ $commandName } <nick>[<message>]: Remove someone from the room. You must be a room moderator to do this.
{ $commandName } <leasainm>[<teachtaireacht>]: Cuir duine éigin amach as an seomra. Ní mór duit a bheith i do mhodhnóir chun é seo a dhéanamh.
{ $commandName } <nick> <message>: Send a private message to a participant in the room.
{ $commandName } <leasainm> <teachtaireacht>: Seol teachtaireacht phríobháideach chuig duine éigin sa seomra.
{ $commandName } <nick> <message>: Send a private message to a user (as opposed to a channel).
{ $commandName } <leasainm> <teachtaireacht>: Seol teachtaireacht phríobháideach chuig úsáideoir (seachas chuig cainéal).
{ $commandName } <nick> [(+|-)<mode>]: Get, set or unset a user's mode.
{ $commandName } <leasainm> [(+|-)<mód>]: Faigh, socraigh, nó díshocraigh mód an úsáideora.
{ $commandName } <nick> <msg>: Sends a CTCP message to the nick.
{ $commandName } <leasainm> <tcht>: Seol teachtaireacht CTCP chuig an leasainm.
{ $commandName } <nick>[ <nick>]* [<channel>]: Invite one or more nicks to join you in the current channel, or to join the specified channel.
{ $commandName } <leasainm>[ <leasainm>]* [<cainéal>]: Tabhair cuireadh do leasainm nó leasainmneacha a bheith leat sa chainéal reatha, nó páirt a ghlacadh sa chainéal sonraithe.
{ $commandName } <nick>: Request the version of a user's client.
{ $commandName } <leasainm>: Faigh leagan de chliant an úsáideora.
{ $commandName } <nick!user@host>: Ban the users matching the given pattern.
{ $commandName } <leasainm!úsáideoir@óstainm>: Cuir cosc ar na húsáideoirí a mheaitseálann an patrún.
{ $commandName } <room1>[ <key1>][,<room2>[ <key2>]]*: Enter one or more channels, optionally providing a channel key for each if needed.
{ $commandName } <seomra1>[ <eochair1>][,<seomra2>[ <eochair2>]]*: Cuir isteach cainéal nó cainéil, in éineacht le heochracha más gá.
{ $commandName } [<room>[@<server>][/<nick>]] [<password>]: Join a room, optionally providing a different server, or nickname, or the room password.
{ $commandName } [<seomra>[@<freastalaí>][/<leasainm>]] [<focal faire>]: Téigh isteach i seomra, le freastalaí, leasainm, nó focal faire roghnach.
{ $commandName } <room jid>[<password>]: Invite your conversation partner to join a room, together with its password if required.
{ $commandName } <seomra jid>[<focal faire>]: Tabhair cuireadh do do chomhpháirtí dul isteach i seomra, in éineacht lena fhocal faire, más gá.
{ $commandName } <target> <message>: Send a notice to a user or channel.
{ $commandName } <sprioc> <teachtaireacht>: Seol fógra chuig úsáideoir nó chuig chainéal.
{ $commandName } [message]: Leave the current channel with an optional message.
{ $commandName } [teachtaireacht]: Fág an cainéal reatha le teachtaireacht roghnach.
{ $commandName }: Request information about the client your conversation partner is using.
